newsitem.title: USA: Maine Gov. sees 2-yr revenue shortfall of $400 mln.
newsitem.headline: Maine Gov. sees 2-yr revenue shortfall of $400 mln.

text.p: NEW YORK, Dec 16 (Reuter) Maine Gov. Angus King's proposed new state budget called for significant cuts in programs and services, and King estimated a revenue shortfall of about $400 million over the next two years.

He said the two-year spending proposal likely will disappoint a lot of people, especially state employees who are likely to face more layoffs. King's budget is expected to be released later this week.
